title: Recording: Gave It All Up by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘Gave It All Up’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 27 January 1977.

It was written by Starr and Vini Poncia, one of six such collaborations on the album.
